mBuff.mDescription:
Loaded DiceTwisted Fate and his allies receive an additional 2 gold per kill.

Total Gold Hustled: @f1@ Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twisted Fate and his allies receive an additional 2 gold per kill.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Twisted Fate and his allies receive an additional <gold>2 gold</gold> per kill.
Twisted Fate has a reduced channel time for Gate.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Red Card Slow</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's movement speed is slowed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Destiny</titleLeft><mainText>Twisted Fate can see all enemy champions and can teleport to any location on the map.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Teleports Twisted Fate to target location in 1.5 seconds.
This character can be seen by all players.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing and slowing all enemy champions. Gate's channel time is also reduced during this duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Twisted Fate <keywordStealth>Reveals</keywordStealth> all enemy champions and <status>Slows</status> by @SlowAmount*100@% for @DebuffDuration@ seconds. While active the channel time for <spellName>Gate</spellName> is reduced to @ReducedChannelTime@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: After channeling, Twisted Fate Teleports to any target location.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: After channeling for @ChannelDuration@ seconds, Twisted Fate Teleports to any target location.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Pick A Card</titleLeft><mainText>Twisted Fate is shuffling the deck, looking for a card.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.

Blue Card deals @BlueDamage@ magic damage and restores @ManaRestore@ Mana.

Red Card deals @RedDamage@ magic damage to units around the target and Slows by @Slow@% for 2.5 seconds.

Gold Card deals @GoldDamage@ magic damage and Stuns for @Stun@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Throws three cards that deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to each enemy unit they pass through.</mainText>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Blue Card</titleLeft><mainText>Twisted Fate's next attack will deal bonus damage and restore mana.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Gold Card</titleLeft><mainText>Twisted Fate's next attack will deal bonus damage and stun the target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Red Card</titleLeft><mainText>Twisted Fate's next attack will deal bonus damage and slow enemies in an area.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
